2. Non-symbol (string, number, object) throws error.
3. Optional schema allows undefined.

We'll write tests using Vitest.

We'll import { expect, test, describe } from 'vitest'; import { ZodSymbol } from './schemas.js';

We'll create a base schema: const schema = ZodSymbol();

But ZodSymbol is a constructor function? In Zod, you call z.symbol() not ZodSymbol directly. But here ZodSymbol is exported as core.$constructor<ZodSymbol>. So you likely call ZodSymbol() to get an instance. So we can do const symbolSchema = ZodSymbol();

Test parse success: const sym = Symbol('test'); expect(symbolSchema.parse(sym)).toBe(sym);

Test parse failure: expect(() => symbolSchema.parse('not a symbol')).toThrow();

Test safeParse: const result = symbolSchema.safeParse(Symbol.iterator); expect(result.success).toBe(true); etc.

Test optional: const optionalSchema = ZodSymbol().optional(); expect(optionalSchema.parse(undefined)).toBe(undefined);

Test nullable: const nullableSchema = ZodSymbol().nullable(); expect(nullableSchema.parse(null)).toBe(null);

Test default: const defaultSchema = ZodSymbol().default(() => Symbol('default')); expect(defaultSchema.parse(undefined)).toBeInstanceOf(Symbol); but default returns a Symbol; we can compare description.

Test refine: const refinedSchema = ZodSymbol().refine(sym => sym.description === 'allowed', { message: 'Invalid symbol description' }); test that Symbol('allowed') passes, Symbol('blocked') fails.

Edge case: Symbol.for('global') passes.

We'll also test that parsing a Symbol object (Object(Symbol())) fails? Actually Symbol() returns primitive symbol, not object. But new Object(Symbol()) is object wrapper; ZodSymbol likely expects typeof value === 'symbol', so object wrapper fails.

We'll include all tests in a single file.
